label: Clayton (St. Louis County seat, not the City of St. Louis)

county_election_office.name: St. Louis County Board of Elections, 725 Northwest Plaza Dr., St. Ann, MO 63074 (the county board, not the City of St. Louis board downtown). Mon to Fri 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.

zip_caveats: Clayton is in St. Louis County. The county’s official election and ZIP maps place ZIP 63105 in County Council District 5 and state House districts 86 and 99. The ZIP reaches Clayton, Ladue and University City, with school districts of the same names. State Senate districts 4, 14 and 24 overlap the ZIP, but Clayton city itself is in Senate District 4. The election uses the 2022 congressional lines: ZIP 63105 falls in Congressional District 1. Use the county’s current Sample Ballot Lookup to confirm your districts and measures.
